content.comment_body: Hello, I would like to know which types of battery voltage sensors work with [product_name]. My goal is to monitor 12VDC from a battery used with a power generator, and if the voltage drops below 12VDC, the sensor should trigger the battery charger to maintain the proper voltage. Any advice would be appreciated.

Hello, [product_name] can use any sensor with an analog output in the 0...10V range, provided analog inputs are available on the device. The [product_name] analog expansion module allows for signals of 0...10V or 0/4...20mA. Hope this information is helpful.

analysis.insight_summary: Users require clear guidance regarding battery voltage sensors compatible with [product_name], aiming to monitor and maintain 12VDC battery levels. Technical details about supported analog input signals and the expansion module provide practical solutions, although initial questions show a need for further documentation and clarification of compatibility.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate thorough support about compatible battery voltage sensors for [product_name], with the capability to monitor 12VDC and enable charging when battery voltage falls below the set level.
